name: Mechanics
blurb: Newton's laws, gravitation, circular & rotational motion, SHM and Kepler's laws — the physics backbone of celestial mechanics.

name: Heat & Thermodynamics
blurb: Thermodynamic equilibrium, ideal gases, energy transfer, black-body radiation, luminosity and Wien's law.

name: Nuclear Physics
blurb: The atom, the hydrogen spectrum, nucleus & radioactivity, and X-rays.

name: Waves & Optics
blurb: Interference, diffraction, polarization, the EM spectrum, optical instruments, Doppler effect and magnitudes. Junior category adds reflection, refraction and lenses.
subtopics: Microwave, Infrared, Ultraviolet, Gamma Rays & Visible Bands

name: Electricity & Magnetism
blurb: Electromagnetic theory and magnetic behaviour; the junior syllabus adds circuits, induction and terrestrial magnetism.
subtopics: Magnetic Lines of Force · Components of Terrestrial Magnetism (Dip & Declination)
Electromagnetic Induction · Fleming's Right Hand Rule

name: The Sun
blurb: Solar structure, the Sun–Earth relation, solar wind & radiation, and eclipses.

name: The Earth
blurb: Atmosphere, longitude & latitude, tides, seasons, meteors and aurorae.

name: The Solar System
blurb: The Earth–Moon system; planets, dwarf planets, asteroids and comets.

name: The Stars
blurb: Stellar life cycles, nebulae, star clusters and the HR Diagram — plus Hand Measurement/Sky Navigation and Bayer Designation, three NAO-unique, high-yield skills.

name: The Universe
blurb: Galaxies, dark matter & dark energy, the origin of the universe, and the Hubble–Lemaître law with its significance.

name: Mathematics
blurb: Statistics, trigonometry, coordinate geometry, transformation, polynomials and conics — the tools every other section uses.

name: Measurement (Junior)
blurb: Junior category only — fundamental & derived units and the relationships between them.

name: Classification of Elements (Junior)
blurb: Junior category only — atomic structure, electronic configuration, valency, bonding and the modern periodic table.
subtopics: Chemical Bond, Radicals, Ions, Molecular Formula

name: Practical: Observation & Data Analysis
blurb: IOAA A.3 — naked-eye & instrument observations, sky maps, magnitude estimation, error calculation, graphing and statistics. Half of all IOAA marks; the NAO closed camp tests it too.
